description: Derived behavioral profile for a (model, harness) pair. Markers are counts over a profiled slice; derivation provenance is mandatory so the derived layer stays separable from observed evidence.

derivation.description: Mandatory provenance for derived (computed) data. Profiles are statistical artifacts, not observed evidence.

dataset_locator.description: Locator of the source rows/files inside the dataset.

dataset_uri.description: URI of the source dataset the profile was computed from.

eval_only.description: True when the source is benchmark/eval trajectories (how models play evals), not observed incident behavior.

expires_after.description: Date after which the profile is stale and must not be used for matching.

extraction_code_hash.description: SHA-256 of the extraction code, when available.

extraction_method.description: How markers were extracted (method name or script reference).

model_version_window.description: Model version(s) the profile covers; profiles must not be matched outside this window.

scaffold_stripped.description: True when harness boilerplate (system prompts, tool schemas, personas) was removed before profiling.

harness.description: Observed harness string, byte-exact. Mirrors the linked harness observable.

markers.description: Marker value to occurrence count within the profiled slice.

model.description: Observed model string, byte-exact. Mirrors the linked model observable.

provenance.description: Where this record's data came from.
